about: Every Meta layout the robot has met live, per robot step, with its fixture, test and expected result (ACL-1433). Source of tests/bench/CATALOGUE.md: edit this file, then run `python scripts/bench_catalogue.py --write`. Status: pass = the robot handles it and the test checks that; xfail = a live robot bug the test exposes (strict xfail, fix belongs to the RPA track); reference = markup check only, no step function on it.
